currentBranchExclusions: FFOR offline receiving, admission, settlement and offline status were removed on 2026-10-28.
qualificationScope.resultMeaning: All original results and counts describe the recorded build; they are not current-branch test status.

checks.name: installed Chicory engine and wallet-core pair with native primary
external payer has a confirmed channel to native primary
installed wallet reviews and creates a skim-fee unified JIT request
installed wallet Activity and balances reflect the native JIT payment
installed wallet restart restores the paid request, balance and channel
installed wallet pays a native primary invoice and records completed Activity
installed wallet prepares an active concurrent-v2 offline reservation
native active offline reservation survives ordinary payments in both directions
restarted native primary settles the external payment while the phone is stopped
installed phone recovers the durable offline receipt after primary restart
second phone reopen preserves one offline credit and one completed Activity row
